subject: Re: Executive roundtable + on-site demo — calendar re-plan for ZenFin visit
body:
From: Susan Nguyen <susan.nguyen@zenfin.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Raj Kapoor <raj.kapoor@zenfin.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Executive roundtable + on-site demo — calendar re-plan for ZenFin visit

Hi Jordan / Marissa —

Thanks for the agenda draft. We just confirmed leadership availability for the 28th but procurement needs the commercial packet before Friday to start internal approvals. Can you also confirm whether SEs can be on-site in SF on the 28th afternoon?

Also, small ask — our security team needs to review a SOC2 excerpt; could you attach the most recent evidence checklist?

Best,
Susan
Head of Platform Ops, ZenFin

---

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Susan Nguyen <susan.nguyen@zenfin.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Raj Kapoor <raj.kapoor@zenfin.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Executive roundtable + on-site demo — calendar re-plan for ZenFin visit

Thanks Susan — quick notes:
- Marissa (SE) can do the on-site afternoon slot on the 28th (we’ll arrive midday).
- Rafael, can you confirm commercial packet / sample SOW delivery by Thursday EOD so Procurement has Friday?
- Attaching the redwood-on-site-deck-zenfin-v2.pdf and the SOC2 excerpt matrix (see attachment stub). If security needs more, we can schedule a short sync with our security lead.

Draft agenda (updated):
- 13:00 — Arrival & quick introductions (Jordan, Susan, Raj, ZenFin Eng leads)
- 13:30 — Prod-focused demo (Marissa, SE deep-dive)
- 14:30 — Ops: security & compliance Q/A (Hannah to join remotely / optional)
- 15:15 — Commercial & procurement touchpoint (Rafael + Procurement)
- 16:00 — Exec roundtable (Jordan + ZenFin leadership)

Let me know if we should flip the exec roundtable earlier.

Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
---

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Susan Nguyen <susan.nguyen@zenfin.com>
Cc: Raj Kapoor <raj.kapoor@zenfin.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Executive roundtable + on-site demo — calendar re-plan for ZenFin visit

Jordan — I’ll have the commercial packet (redwood commercial packet + sample SOW) ready by Thursday 17:00 PT. I will also include a short pricing appendix and the proposed term language for the pilot.

Monica, can you draft the MP schedule for the procurement intro and include the PO flow? Susan, if procurement wants a short checklist for vendor onboarding, I’ll include it.

Rafael Mendes
Director, Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Susan Nguyen <susan.nguyen@zenfin.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Executive roundtable + on-site demo — calendar re-plan for ZenFin visit

Thanks all — small update on logistics:
- I need to change the demo topology to include a private VPC example since Susan flagged data residency questions; will bring the VPC runbook and a short notebook of the request/response flow.
- Hannah — can you join remotely at 14:30 to cover SOC2 artifacts and retention policy? If yes, please confirm timezone (I’ll send a calendar invite for 14:30 PT).

Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

---

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Susan Nguyen <susan.nguyen@zenfin.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 10:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Executive roundtable + on-site demo — calendar re-plan for ZenFin visit

I can do 14:30 PT remotely. I’ll bring the SOC2 excerpt and the retention table. If ZenFin security has specific questions, can they send them in advance? Ilya (copied below) will likely chime in from their side.

Hannah Schmitt
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference

---

From: Susan Nguyen <susan.nguyen@zenfin.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Raj Kapoor <raj.kapoor@zenfin.com>, Ilya Petrov <ilya.petrov@zenfin.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@zenfin.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Executive roundtable + on-site demo — calendar re-plan for ZenFin visit

Appreciate the quick turn. A couple notes from procurement/security:
- Procurement confirms the 28th afternoon is fine but requests the PO template by Friday.
- Security sent a short tech Q/A (attached to this thread) — Ilya will own pushing those to our vendors.
- One calendar ask: can we start the exec roundtable at 15:30 PT instead of 16:00 to accommodate our CEO’s prior call?

If you can shift to 15:30, we’ll finalize travel and exec availability.

Thanks,
Susan

---

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Susan Nguyen <susan.nguyen@zenfin.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Raj Kapoor <raj.kapoor@zenfin.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 16:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Executive roundtable + on-site demo — calendar re-plan for ZenFin visit

Susan — we can move the exec roundtable to 15:30 PT. Updated agenda and calendar invite sent (invitation: ZenFin on-site — 28 Sep — Redwood demo & exec roundtable).

Action items summary:
- Rafael: PO template + commercial packet by Thu 17:00 PT (attaching packet stub).
- Marissa: VPC runbook + private demo notebook (in deck).
- Hannah: SOC2 excerpt + retention table; will be on the 14:30 PT remote call.
- Ilya / ZenFin security: send tech Qs before Thu EOD so Hannah can review.
- Jordan: send finalized calendar invite and logistics (done).

Attachments referenced: redwood-on-site-deck-zenfin-v2.pdf; zenfin-soc2-evidence-request.xlsx

See you on the 28th — travel details to follow.

Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=zenfin-onsite-20260928
